Hi Hannah / Redwood team,

Thanks for moving quickly here — we're starting vendor setup for Acme Analytics' pilot and Procurement needs a short service-level playbook we can attach to our PO file. Can you send a one-page (or short packet) that includes:

- Primary and secondary support contacts (email + phone)
- Escalation path (who to call for P1 / P2, and expected response times)
- Uptime targets / availability commitments you recommend for the pilot (we'll propose to our stakeholders)
- Billing contact and PO instructions (PO address, invoice email, payment terms)
- Any onboarding forms or templates you require (W-9 if US, vendor setup form, etc.)

If possible, please include a contact roster template we can fill and return. We're aiming to issue a PO by end of next week, so a kickoff doc by EOD Wed would be ideal.

Thanks,

Sam — thanks for the clear checklist. We're happy to align and I've attached a support roster template to speed the setup. High-level answers below; I'll loop in Marissa for billing/PO specifics.

Quick answers:
- Support contacts: primary (Marissa Cole, Support Ops), secondary (Rishi Malhotra, Escalations). We will provide direct phone numbers in the roster but prefer email for initial contact.
- Escalation path: P1 incidents -> on-call engineer (target ack < 15 min) -> escalation to Rishi (target ack < 30 min) -> engineering lead and account manager notified within 1 hour. We'll include an escalation matrix PDF.
- Uptime targets: For the pilot we typically propose 99.5% monthly availability; can discuss tightening to 99.9% for production with a committed SLA and credits.
- Billing / PO: Billing inbox is billing@redwood.com; standard net30 terms for pilot customers unless otherwise negotiated. PO should reference deal id RDW-2026-ACM-347 and be sent to billing@redwood.com.
- Onboarding forms: we require a completed vendor setup form and W-9 (US). Attached is the support roster template; we'll follow up with the vendor setup form.

Proposed next steps:
1) Fill and return the attached support_roster_template.xlsx with the contact names and phone numbers.
2) Schedule a 30-minute kickoff with our CS/Support ops (I can propose times Wed/Thu).
3) Once PO is issued, Marissa will confirm billing and finalize any invoice instructions.

Attachments: support_roster_template.xlsx (template)

—

Hi Sam — following up with the deliverables and answers you requested.

Attachments: redwood_sla_summary.pdf, escalation_matrix_v1.pdf

1) Coverage and P1 handling
- We operate 24/7 on-call for Sev 1 incidents. The <15 minute acknowledgement is our target and standard operating metric for on-call; for Sev 1 incidents during the pilot we commit to an initial acknowledgement within 30 minutes and a remediation cadence documented in the escalation matrix. For production-grade SLAs (99.9%) we provide tighter SLOs with credit terms.

2) Credit / remediation example (pilot / 99.5%)
- If monthly availability falls between 99.0%–99.5% we offer a service credit of 5% of the monthly invoice. Below 99.0% we escalate to the account leadership and propose a remediation plan; credits may scale up to 15% depending on duration and impact. We'll include the formal calculation in the SLA packet (see redwood_sla_summary.pdf).

3) SOC 2 & security evidence
- Link to our latest SOC 2 (Type II) summary and the report request process: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/SOC2/Redwood_Soc2_Report_2025.pdf
- For full report access we follow a standard NDA / report access request flow — let us know if your security team wants the redacted summary first; we can coordinate a secure transfer.

4) PO and billing
- Please send PO referencing RDW-2026-ACM-347 to billing@redwood.com. Invoices should reference the PO number. Standard pilot payment term: net30 unless otherwise agreed prior to PO issuance.

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm kickoff time Thu 9 Sep 10:00 PT (we'll send calendar invite).
- Acme: return the completed support_roster_template.xlsx with named on-call contacts.
- Redwood: we'll share the escalation_matrix_v1.pdf and the SLA summary (attached) for your procurement file.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Marissa Cole
